description: Black wool central leg pleats, slacks/pants, weathered; loose fitting; small pocket on top right side. Zipper and metal clasp on left hip. Knize label on inside near zipper.  Moth damage. "KNIZE 3/22/1955" Fabric almost identical to 0428, 0383, 0380 - side pockets have been sewn closed. Earliest tailored black pants in the archive. Vienna?
